name: structural-scanner-in-base-package
body: The structural scanner ships in the base apg package, not as a separate per-format formula: `build.rs` compiles one binary (`structfrontend`) and stages it to `target/<profile>/frontends`, and the base Homebrew/installer artifacts carry it. `apg-md` retires as a separate formula, so the frontend set becomes the base `scanner` plus seven frontends (`apg-go`, `apg-java`, `apg-cpp`, `apg-rust`, `apg-ts`, `apg-csharp`, `apg-py`). Acceptance: the base package installs and runs the structural scanner with no extra install step, and the `apg-md` formula is gone.
